questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A roundabout is ahead. Slow down when entering and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding together. This signal tells other riders to follow you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. This sign warns you that wet roads are slippery and harder to control. Drive carefully in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: The shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control. Stay calm and steer back onto the road gently.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that multiple curves are coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. Come to a full stop and look for pedestrians and crossing traffic. Only go when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed to drive when exiting a highway. In this example, 30 mph is the recommended speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that a crossroad is ahead. Be prepared for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet. Slow down and drive with extra caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a lane is ending soon. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending soon. Move to another lane to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, it is a hand signal for the group to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that parking is not allowed in this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right. The left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Yield to all vehicles and pedestrians in or entering the intersection. Proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not permitted at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that bicycles may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow down and let pedestrians and other traffic pass before you proceed. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A person is ahead controlling traffic in a construction zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A steep downhill section is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: Workers are in the area ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: These parking spaces are only for people with valid disabled parking permits.
